preconditions.description: The number of elements n must be an even integer between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n // 2 and all(1 <= xi <= 200000 for xi in x)
preconditions.description: The input list x must contain n/2 positive integers, each between 1 and 200000.

postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output 'No'; otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by n positive integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**13 for xi in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All output integers must be positive and within the range of 1 to 10^13.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(stdout.split()[1:i+1]) == int((i+1)**2) for i in range(0, n, 2))
postconditions.description: The sum of the first i elements must be a perfect square for all even i.
